SELECT COUNT(*) AS SoDonMangVe FROM vw_ai_quanly WHERE LoaiBanGhi = 'ORDER' AND BusinessDate = CURRENT_DATE AND LoaiDon = 'Mang về' LIMIT 500

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT MaOrder) AS SoDonMangVe FROM vw_ai_thungan WHERE LoaiBanGhi = 'ORDER' AND BusinessDate = CURRENT_DATE AND LoaiDon = 'Mang về' LIMIT 500
SELECT AVG(TongTien) AS TrungBinhMoiHoaDon FROM vw_ai_quanly WHERE LoaiBanGhi = 'HOA_DON' AND BusinessDate = CURRENT_DATE LIMIT 500
SELECT COUNT(*) AS SoLuongGiaoDichKho FROM vw_ai_kho WHERE LoaiBanGhi = 'GIAO_DICH_KHO' LIMIT 500
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT MaGiaoDich) AS SoGiaoDichTienMat FROM vw_ai_thungan WHERE LoaiBanGhi = 'THANH_TOAN' AND BusinessDate = CURRENT_DATE AND PhuongThuc = 'Tiền mặt' LIMIT 500
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT MaOrder) AS SoDonDangMo FROM vw_ai_quanly WHERE LoaiBanGhi = 'ORDER' AND TrangThaiOrder = 'Đang mở' LIMIT 500
SELECT MAX(SoLuongTon) AS MaxTonKho FROM vw_ai_kho WHERE LoaiBanGhi = 'TON_KHO' LIMIT 500
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT MaBan) AS SoBanDuocPhucVu FROM vw_ai_quanly WHERE LoaiBanGhi = 'ORDER' AND BusinessDate = CURRENT_DATE LIMIT 500
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT MaOrder) AS SoDonBiHuy FROM vw_ai_quanly WHERE LoaiBanGhi = 'ORDER' AND BusinessDate = CURRENT_DATE AND TrangThaiOrder = 'Đã hủy' LIMIT 500
SELECT SUM(SoLuong) AS TongSoLuongNhap FROM vw_ai_kho WHERE LoaiBanGhi = 'GIAO_DICH_KHO' AND LoaiGiaoDich = 'Nhập' LIMIT 500
SELECT COUNT(*) AS SoHoaDon FROM vw_ai_thungan WHERE LoaiBanGhi = 'HOA_DON' AND BusinessDate = CURRENT_DATE LIMIT 500
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT MaNguyenLieu) AS SoLuongNguyenLieu FROM vw_ai_quanly WHERE LoaiBanGhi = 'TON_KHO' LIMIT 500
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT MaNguyenLieu) AS SoNguyenLieuHetHang FROM vw_ai_kho WHERE LoaiBanGhi = 'TON_KHO' AND SoLuongTon = 0 LIMIT 500

SELECT BusinessDate AS Ngay, SUM(TongTien) AS DoanhThu FROM vw_ai_quanly WHERE LoaiBanGhi = 'HOA_DON' AND YEAR(BusinessDate) = YEAR(CURRENT_DATE) AND MONTH(BusinessDate) = MONTH(CURRENT_DATE) GROUP BY BusinessDate ORDER BY BusinessDate LIMIT 500

SELECT MaBan, SUM(TongTien) AS DoanhThu FROM vw_ai_quanly WHERE LoaiBanGhi = 'HOA_DON' AND NOT MaBan IS NULL AND DATE_FORMAT(BusinessDate, '%Y-%m') = DATE_FORMAT(CURRENT_DATE, '%Y-%m') GROUP BY MaBan ORDER BY DoanhThu DESC LIMIT 5
SELECT PhuongThuc, SUM(SoTien) AS DoanhThu FROM vw_ai_quanly WHERE LoaiBanGhi = 'THANH_TOAN' AND DATE_FORMAT(BusinessDate, '%Y%m') = DATE_FORMAT(CURRENT_DATE, '%Y%m') GROUP BY PhuongThuc LIMIT 500

SELECT BusinessDate, COUNT(DISTINCT MaOrder) AS SoDon FROM vw_ai_quanly WHERE LoaiBanGhi = 'ORDER' AND BusinessDate BETWEEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE, INTERVAL (WEEKDAY(CURRENT_DATE) + 7) DAY) AND DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE, INTERVAL (WEEKDAY(CURRENT_DATE) + 1) DAY) GROUP BY BusinessDate ORDER BY BusinessDate LIMIT 500

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(BusinessDate, '%m') AS Thang, COUNT(DISTINCT MaHoaDon) AS SoHoaDon FROM vw_ai_quanly WHERE LoaiBanGhi = 'HOA_DON' AND YEAR(BusinessDate) = YEAR(CURRENT_DATE) GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(BusinessDate, '%m') ORDER BY Thang LIMIT 500

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(BusinessDate, '%Y-%m') AS Thang, SUM(TongTien) AS DoanhThu FROM vw_ai_quanly WHERE LoaiBanGhi = 'HOA_DON' AND YEAR(BusinessDate) = YEAR(CURRENT_DATE) GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(BusinessDate, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY Thang LIMIT 500

SELECT LoaiDon, COUNT(MaOrder) AS SoDon FROM vw_ai_quanly WHERE LoaiBanGhi = 'ORDER' AND BusinessDate >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '29' DAY AND LoaiDon IN ('Tại chỗ', 'Mang về') GROUP BY LoaiDon LIMIT 500

SELECT PhuongThuc, SUM(SoTien) AS TongTien FROM vw_ai_quanly WHERE LoaiBanGhi = 'THANH_TOAN' AND BusinessDate >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE, INTERVAL '7' DAY) AND BusinessDate <= CURRENT_DATE GROUP BY PhuongThuc LIMIT 500

SELECT BusinessDate, SUM(TongTien) AS DoanhThu FROM vw_ai_quanly WHERE LoaiBanGhi = 'HOA_DON' AND DATE_FORMAT(BusinessDate, '%Y-%m') = DATE_FORMAT(CURRENT_DATE, '%Y-%m') GROUP BY BusinessDate ORDER BY DoanhThu DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(ThoiDiemXuat, '%H') AS Gio, COUNT(*) AS SoHoaDon FROM vw_ai_quanly WHERE LoaiBanGhi = 'HOA_DON' AND BusinessDate = DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE, INTERVAL '1' DAY) GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(ThoiDiemXuat, '%H') ORDER BY Gio LIMIT 500

SELECT SUM(TongTien) / 30 AS DoanhThuTrungBinhMoiNgay FROM vw_ai_quanly WHERE LoaiBanGhi = 'HOA_DON' AND BusinessDate >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE, INTERVAL '29' DAY) AND BusinessDate <= CURRENT_DATE LIMIT 500

SELECT BusinessDate, DAYOFWEEK(BusinessDate) AS ThuTrongTuan, COUNT(*) AS SoGiaoDich FROM vw_ai_quanly WHERE LoaiBanGhi = 'THANH_TOAN' AND YEARWEEK(BusinessDate, 1) = YEARWEEK(CURRENT_DATE, 1) GROUP BY BusinessDate, DAYOFWEEK(BusinessDate) ORDER BY BusinessDate LIMIT 500
SELECT MaNguyenLieu, TenNguyenLieu, DonViTinh, SoLuongTon FROM vw_ai_quanly WHERE LoaiBanGhi = 'TON_KHO' ORDER BY SoLuongTon DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT BusinessDate, COUNT(DISTINCT MaOrder) AS SoDonBiHuy FROM vw_ai_quanly WHERE LoaiBanGhi = 'ORDER' AND TrangThaiOrder = 'Đã hủy' AND DATE_FORMAT(BusinessDate, '%Y-%m') = DATE_FORMAT(CURRENT_DATE, '%Y-%m') GROUP BY BusinessDate ORDER BY BusinessDate LIMIT 500

SELECT MaBan, SUM(TongTien) AS DoanhThu FROM vw_ai_quanly WHERE LoaiBanGhi = 'HOA_DON' AND BusinessDate BETWEEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE, INTERVAL '6' DAY) AND CURRENT_DATE GROUP BY MaBan ORDER BY MaBan LIMIT 500

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(BusinessDate, '%Y-%m') AS Thang, COUNT(DISTINCT MaHoaDon) AS SoHoaDon FROM vw_ai_quanly WHERE LoaiBanGhi = 'HOA_DON' AND BusinessDate >= DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE, INTERVAL '5' MONTH), '%Y-%m-01') GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(BusinessDate, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY Thang LIMIT 500

SELECT BusinessDate, SUM(SoTien) AS DoanhThu FROM vw_ai_thungan WHERE LoaiBanGhi = 'THANH_TOAN' AND BusinessDate >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE, INTERVAL (WEEKDAY(CURRENT_DATE)) DAY) AND BusinessDate < DATE_ADD(DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE, INTERVAL (WEEKDAY(CURRENT_DATE)) DAY), INTERVAL '7' DAY) GROUP BY BusinessDate ORDER BY BusinessDate LIMIT 500

SELECT HOUR(ThoiDiemXuat) AS Gio, COUNT(DISTINCT MaHoaDon) AS SoHoaDon FROM vw_ai_thungan WHERE LoaiBanGhi = 'HOA_DON' AND BusinessDate = CURRENT_DATE GROUP BY HOUR(ThoiDiemXuat) ORDER BY Gio LIMIT 500

SELECT BusinessDate, SUM(TongTien) AS DoanhThu FROM vw_ai_thungan WHERE LoaiBanGhi = 'HOA_DON' AND YEAR(BusinessDate) = YEAR(CURRENT_DATE) AND MONTH(BusinessDate) = MONTH(CURRENT_DATE) GROUP BY BusinessDate ORDER BY DoanhThu DESC LIMIT 5
SELECT PhuongThuc, COUNT(DISTINCT MaOrder) AS SoDon FROM vw_ai_thungan WHERE LoaiBanGhi = 'THANH_TOAN' AND BusinessDate >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE, INTERVAL '30' DAY) GROUP BY PhuongThuc LIMIT 500

SELECT BusinessDate, SUM(SoTien) AS TongTienThu FROM vw_ai_thungan WHERE LoaiBanGhi = 'THANH_TOAN' AND BusinessDate >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE, INTERVAL '6' DAY) AND BusinessDate <= CURRENT_DATE GROUP BY BusinessDate ORDER BY BusinessDate LIMIT 500

SELECT BusinessDate, COUNT(DISTINCT MaHoaDon) AS SoHoaDon FROM vw_ai_thungan WHERE LoaiBanGhi = 'HOA_DON' AND YEAR(BusinessDate) = YEAR(CURRENT_DATE) AND MONTH(BusinessDate) = MONTH(CURRENT_DATE) GROUP BY BusinessDate ORDER BY BusinessDate LIMIT 500

SELECT BusinessDate, SUM(SoLuong) AS TongSoLuongNhap FROM vw_ai_kho WHERE LoaiBanGhi = 'GIAO_DICH_KHO' AND LoaiGiaoDich = 'Nhập' AND YEAR(BusinessDate) = YEAR(CURRENT_DATE) AND MONTH(BusinessDate) = MONTH(CURRENT_DATE) GROUP BY BusinessDate ORDER BY BusinessDate LIMIT 500
SELECT MaNguyenLieu, TenNguyenLieu, DonViTinh, SoLuongTon FROM vw_ai_kho WHERE LoaiBanGhi = 'TON_KHO' ORDER BY SoLuongTon ASC LIMIT 5
SELECT LoaiGiaoDich, COUNT(DISTINCT MaGiaoDichKho) AS SoGiaoDich FROM vw_ai_kho WHERE LoaiBanGhi = 'GIAO_DICH_KHO' GROUP BY LoaiGiaoDich LIMIT 500
SELECT MaNguyenLieu, TenNguyenLieu, DonViTinh, SoLuongTon FROM vw_ai_kho WHERE LoaiBanGhi = 'TON_KHO' LIMIT 500

SELECT MaNguyenLieu, TenNguyenLieu, SUM(SoLuong) AS TongSoLuongNhap FROM vw_ai_kho WHERE LoaiBanGhi = 'GIAO_DICH_KHO' AND LoaiGiaoDich = 'Nhập' AND BusinessDate >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE, INTERVAL '30' DAY) GROUP BY MaNguyenLieu, TenNguyenLieu LIMIT 500

SELECT ROUND(((SELECT SUM(TongTien) FROM vw_ai_quanly WHERE LoaiBanGhi = 'HOA_DON' AND DATE_FORMAT(BusinessDate, '%Y%m') = DATE_FORMAT(CURRENT_DATE, '%Y%m')) - (SELECT SUM(TongTien) FROM vw_ai_quanly WHERE LoaiBanGhi = 'HOA_DON' AND DATE_FORMAT(BusinessDate, '%Y%m') = DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE, INTERVAL '1' MONTH), '%Y%m'))) * 100.0 / NULLIF((SELECT SUM(TongTien) FROM vw_ai_quanly WHERE LoaiBanGhi = 'HOA_DON' AND DATE_FORMAT(BusinessDate, '%Y%m') = DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE, INTERVAL '1' MONTH), '%Y%m')), 0), 2) AS PhanTramTangGiam LIMIT 500

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(BusinessDate, '%Y-%m') AS Thang, ROUND(SUM(TongTien) / COUNT(DISTINCT MaOrder), 2) AS DoanhThuTrungBinhMoiDon FROM vw_ai_quanly WHERE LoaiBanGhi = 'HOA_DON' AND YEAR(BusinessDate) = YEAR(CURRENT_DATE) GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(BusinessDate, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY Thang LIMIT 500

SELECT BusinessDate FROM vw_ai_quanly WHERE LoaiBanGhi = 'HOA_DON' AND YEAR(BusinessDate) = YEAR(CURRENT_DATE) AND MONTH(BusinessDate) = MONTH(CURRENT_DATE) GROUP BY BusinessDate HAVING SUM(TongTien) > (SELECT AVG(DailyRevenue) FROM (SELECT SUM(TongTien) AS DailyRevenue FROM vw_ai_quanly WHERE LoaiBanGhi = 'HOA_DON' AND YEAR(BusinessDate) = YEAR(CURRENT_DATE) AND MONTH(BusinessDate) = MONTH(CURRENT_DATE) GROUP BY BusinessDate) AS Daily) ORDER BY BusinessDate LIMIT 500

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(ThoiDiemXuat, '%Y-%m-%d %H:00:00') AS Gio, SUM(TongTien) AS DoanhThu FROM vw_ai_quanly WHERE LoaiBanGhi = 'HOA_DON' AND BusinessDate >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE, INTERVAL '7' DAY) AND BusinessDate <= CURRENT_DATE GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(ThoiDiemXuat, '%Y-%m-%d %H:00:00') ORDER BY Gio LIMIT 500

SELECT LoaiDon, DATE_FORMAT(BusinessDate, '%Y-%m') AS Thang, COUNT(DISTINCT MaOrder) AS SoDon FROM vw_ai_quanly WHERE LoaiBanGhi = 'ORDER' AND BusinessDate >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE, INTERVAL '3' MONTH) GROUP BY LoaiDon, DATE_FORMAT(BusinessDate, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY Thang, LoaiDon LIMIT 500

SELECT r.MaBan, r.BusinessDate, r.DoanhThu FROM (SELECT d.MaBan, d.BusinessDate, d.DoanhThu, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d.MaBan ORDER BY d.DoanhThu DESC) AS rnk FROM (SELECT o.MaBan, hd.BusinessDate, SUM(hd.TongTien) AS DoanhThu FROM vw_ai_quanly AS hd JOIN vw_ai_quanly AS o ON o.LoaiBanGhi = 'ORDER' AND o.MaOrder = hd.MaOrder WHERE hd.LoaiBanGhi = 'HOA_DON' AND DATE_FORMAT(hd.BusinessDate, '%Y%m') = DATE_FORMAT(CURRENT_DATE, '%Y%m') GROUP BY o.MaBan, hd.BusinessDate) AS d) AS r WHERE r.rnk = 1 LIMIT 500

SELECT BusinessDate, SUM(TongTien) AS DoanhThuNgay, SUM(SUM(TongTien)) OVER (ORDER BY BusinessDate) AS DoanhThuLuyKe FROM vw_ai_quanly WHERE LoaiBanGhi = 'HOA_DON' AND BusinessDate >= DATE_FORMAT(CURRENT_DATE, '%Y-%m-01') AND BusinessDate < DATE_FORMAT(DATE_ADD(CURRENT_DATE, INTERVAL '1' MONTH), '%Y-%m-01') GROUP BY BusinessDate ORDER BY BusinessDate LIMIT 500

SELECT MaNguyenLieu, TenNguyenLieu, DonViTinh, SoLuongTon FROM vw_ai_quanly WHERE LoaiBanGhi = 'TON_KHO' AND SoLuongTon > (SELECT AVG(SoLuongTon) FROM vw_ai_quanly WHERE LoaiBanGhi = 'TON_KHO') LIMIT 500

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(BusinessDate, '%Y-%m') AS Thang, COUNT(DISTINCT MaOrder) / DAY(LAST_DAY(MAX(BusinessDate))) AS SoDonTrungBinhMoiNgay FROM vw_ai_quanly WHERE LoaiBanGhi = 'ORDER' AND YEAR(BusinessDate) = YEAR(CURRENT_DATE) GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(BusinessDate, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY Thang LIMIT 500

SELECT PhuongThuc, SUM(SoTien) AS TongSoTien, ROUND(SUM(SoTien) * 100 / SUM(SUM(SoTien)) OVER (), 2) AS TiLePhanTram FROM vw_ai_quanly WHERE LoaiBanGhi = 'THANH_TOAN' AND BusinessDate >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE, INTERVAL '30' DAY) AND BusinessDate <= CURRENT_DATE GROUP BY PhuongThuc ORDER BY TongSoTien DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT HOUR(ThoiDiemXuat) AS Gio, SUM(TongTien) AS DoanhThu FROM vw_ai_thungan WHERE LoaiBanGhi = 'HOA_DON' AND BusinessDate >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE, INTERVAL '30' DAY) AND BusinessDate <= CURRENT_DATE GROUP BY HOUR(ThoiDiemXuat) ORDER BY DoanhThu DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT BusinessDate AS Ngay, SUM(TongTien) AS DoanhThuNgay, SUM(SUM(TongTien)) OVER (ORDER BY BusinessDate) AS DoanhThuLuyKe FROM vw_ai_thungan WHERE LoaiBanGhi = 'HOA_DON' AND YEAR(BusinessDate) = YEAR(CURRENT_DATE) AND MONTH(BusinessDate) = MONTH(CURRENT_DATE) GROUP BY BusinessDate ORDER BY BusinessDate LIMIT 500

SELECT BusinessDate, COUNT(DISTINCT MaOrder) AS SoDon FROM vw_ai_thungan WHERE LoaiBanGhi = 'ORDER' AND BusinessDate >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE, INTERVAL '29' DAY) AND BusinessDate <= CURRENT_DATE GROUP BY BusinessDate HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT MaOrder) > (SELECT AVG(DailyCount) FROM (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT MaOrder) AS DailyCount FROM vw_ai_thungan WHERE LoaiBanGhi = 'ORDER' AND BusinessDate >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE, INTERVAL '29' DAY) AND BusinessDate <= CURRENT_DATE GROUP BY BusinessDate) AS t) ORDER BY BusinessDate LIMIT 500

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN YEARWEEK(BusinessDate, 1) = YEARWEEK(CURRENT_DATE, 1) THEN TongTien ELSE 0 END) AS DoanhThuTuanNay, SUM(CASE WHEN YEARWEEK(BusinessDate, 1) = YEARWEEK(DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE, INTERVAL '1' WEEK), 1) THEN TongTien ELSE 0 END) AS DoanhThuTuanTruoc, SUM(CASE WHEN YEARWEEK(BusinessDate, 1) = YEARWEEK(CURRENT_DATE, 1) THEN TongTien ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN YEARWEEK(BusinessDate, 1) = YEARWEEK(DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE, INTERVAL '1' WEEK), 1) THEN TongTien ELSE 0 END) AS ChenhLech FROM vw_ai_thungan WHERE LoaiBanGhi = 'HOA_DON' AND YEARWEEK(BusinessDate, 1) IN (YEARWEEK(CURRENT_DATE, 1), YEARWEEK(DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE, INTERVAL '1' WEEK), 1)) LIMIT 500

SELECT MaNguyenLieu, TenNguyenLieu, DonViTinh, SoLuongTon, MucTonToiThieu, CanhBaoTonThap FROM vw_ai_kho WHERE LoaiBanGhi = 'TON_KHO' AND SoLuongTon < (SELECT AVG(SoLuongTon) FROM vw_ai_kho WHERE LoaiBanGhi = 'TON_KHO') LIMIT 500
SELECT LoaiGiaoDich FROM vw_ai_kho WHERE LoaiBanGhi = 'GIAO_DICH_KHO' AND BusinessDate >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE, INTERVAL '30' DAY) GROUP BY LoaiGiaoDich ORDER BY SUM(SoLuong) DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT MaNguyenLieu, TenNguyenLieu, DonViTinh, SUM(CASE WHEN LoaiGiaoDich = 'Nhập' THEN SoLuong ELSE 0 END) AS SoLuongNhap, SUM(CASE WHEN LoaiGiaoDich = 'Xuất thủ công' THEN SoLuong ELSE 0 END) AS SoLuongXuat FROM vw_ai_kho WHERE LoaiBanGhi = 'GIAO_DICH_KHO' AND BusinessDate >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE, INTERVAL '30' DAY) GROUP BY MaNguyenLieu, TenNguyenLieu, DonViTinh ORDER BY MaNguyenLieu LIMIT 500

SELECT BusinessDate, COUNT(DISTINCT MaGiaoDichKho) AS SoGiaoDich FROM vw_ai_kho WHERE LoaiBanGhi = 'GIAO_DICH_KHO' AND DATE_FORMAT(BusinessDate, '%Y-%m') = DATE_FORMAT(CURRENT_DATE, '%Y-%m') GROUP BY BusinessDate ORDER BY SoGiaoDich DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT DISTINCT MaNguyenLieu, TenNguyenLieu, DonViTinh FROM vw_ai_kho WHERE LoaiBanGhi = 'TON_KHO' AND NOT MaNguyenLieu IN (SELECT MaNguyenLieu FROM vw_ai_kho WHERE LoaiBanGhi = 'GIAO_DICH_KHO') LIMIT 500
SELECT TenMon FROM vw_ai_quanly WHERE LoaiBanGhi = 'DONG_MON' AND YEARWEEK(BusinessDate, 1) = YEARWEEK(CURRENT_DATE, 1) GROUP BY TenMon ORDER BY SUM(SoLuongMon) DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT TenMon, SUM(ThanhTienMon) AS DoanhThu FROM vw_ai_quanly WHERE LoaiBanGhi = 'DONG_MON' AND YEAR(BusinessDate) = YEAR(CURRENT_DATE) AND MONTH(BusinessDate) = MONTH(CURRENT_DATE) GROUP BY TenMon ORDER BY DoanhThu ASC LIMIT 1
SELECT DonGiaNhap FROM vw_ai_quanly WHERE LoaiBanGhi = 'PHIEU_NHAP' AND TenNguyenLieu = 'Thịt bò' ORDER BY BusinessDate DESC, MaPhieuNhap DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(dm.ThanhTienMon), 0) AS TongGiaTriOrderHuy FROM vw_ai_quanly AS dm JOIN vw_ai_quanly AS o ON o.MaOrder = dm.MaOrder WHERE dm.LoaiBanGhi = 'DONG_MON' AND o.LoaiBanGhi = 'ORDER' AND o.TrangThaiOrder = 'Đã hủy' AND DATE_FORMAT(o.BusinessDate, '%Y-%m') = DATE_FORMAT(CURRENT_DATE, '%Y-%m') LIMIT 500

SELECT LyDoHuyOrder, COUNT(*) AS SoLanXuatHien FROM vw_ai_quanly WHERE LoaiBanGhi = 'ORDER' AND BusinessDate >= DATE_FORMAT(CURRENT_DATE, '%Y-%m-01') AND BusinessDate < DATE_ADD(DATE_FORMAT(CURRENT_DATE, '%Y-%m-01'), INTERVAL '1' MONTH) AND NOT LyDoHuyOrder IS NULL AND LyDoHuyOrder <> '' GROUP BY LyDoHuyOrder ORDER BY SoLanXuatHien DESC LIMIT 500

SELECT TenNhom, SUM(ThanhTienMon) AS DoanhThu FROM vw_ai_quanly WHERE LoaiBanGhi = 'DONG_MON' AND DATE_FORMAT(BusinessDate, '%Y%m') = DATE_FORMAT(CURRENT_DATE, '%Y%m') GROUP BY TenNhom ORDER BY DoanhThu DESC LIMIT 3
SELECT GiaBinhQuanThang FROM vw_ai_quanly WHERE LoaiBanGhi = 'GIA_VON_THANG' AND TenNguyenLieu = 'Gạo tẻ' AND Thang = DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE, INTERVAL '1' MONTH), '%Y%m') LIMIT 1

SELECT TenNhaCungCap, SUM(DonGiaNhap * SoLuongNhap) AS TongGiaTriNhap FROM vw_ai_quanly WHERE LoaiBanGhi = 'PHIEU_NHAP' AND BusinessDate >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE, INTERVAL '30' DAY) AND BusinessDate <= CURRENT_DATE GROUP BY TenNhaCungCap ORDER BY TongGiaTriNhap DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT ROUND(((SELECT COALESCE(SUM(TongTien), 0) FROM vw_ai_quanly WHERE LoaiBanGhi = 'HOA_DON' AND DATE_FORMAT(BusinessDate, '%Y%m') = DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE, INTERVAL '1' MONTH), '%Y%m')) - (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(ABS(gd.SoLuong) * gv.GiaBinhQuanThang), 0) FROM vw_ai_quanly AS gd JOIN vw_ai_quanly AS gv ON gv.LoaiBanGhi = 'GIA_VON_THANG' AND gv.MaNguyenLieu = gd.MaNguyenLieu AND gv.Thang = DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE, INTERVAL '1' MONTH), '%Y%m') WHERE gd.LoaiBanGhi = 'GIAO_DICH_KHO' AND gd.LoaiGiaoDich = 'Trừ tự động' AND DATE_FORMAT(gd.BusinessDate, '%Y%m') = DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE, INTERVAL '1' MONTH), '%Y%m'))) / NULLIF((SELECT SUM(TongTien) FROM vw_ai_quanly WHERE LoaiBanGhi = 'HOA_DON' AND DATE_FORMAT(BusinessDate, '%Y%m') = DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE, INTERVAL '1' MONTH), '%Y%m')), 0) * 100, 2) AS BienLoiNhuanGopUocTinhThangTruoc LIMIT 500

SELECT MaNguyenLieu, TenNguyenLieu, SUM(CASE WHEN LoaiGiaoDich = 'Nhập' THEN SoLuong ELSE 0 END) AS SoLuongNhap, SUM(CASE WHEN LoaiGiaoDich = 'Trừ tự động' THEN SoLuong ELSE 0 END) AS SoLuongTieuHao FROM vw_ai_quanly WHERE LoaiBanGhi = 'GIAO_DICH_KHO' AND BusinessDate >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE, INTERVAL '30' DAY) GROUP BY MaNguyenLieu, TenNguyenLieu ORDER BY MaNguyenLieu LIMIT 500
SELECT TenMon, SUM(SoLuongMon) AS TongSoLuong FROM vw_ai_thungan WHERE LoaiBanGhi = 'DONG_MON' AND BusinessDate = CURRENT_DATE GROUP BY TenMon ORDER BY TongSoLuong DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT dm.TenMon, SUM(dm.ThanhTienMon) AS DoanhThu FROM vw_ai_thungan AS dm JOIN vw_ai_thungan AS o ON o.LoaiBanGhi = 'ORDER' AND o.MaOrder = dm.MaOrder WHERE dm.LoaiBanGhi = 'DONG_MON' AND dm.BusinessDate >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE, INTERVAL '6' DAY) AND dm.BusinessDate <= CURRENT_DATE AND o.TrangThaiOrder = 'Đã thanh toán' GROUP BY dm.TenMon ORDER BY DoanhThu DESC LIMIT 500

SELECT DISTINCT TenMon, DonGiaMon FROM vw_ai_thungan WHERE LoaiBanGhi = 'DONG_MON' AND BusinessDate = CURRENT_DATE AND SoLuongMon > 0 AND DonGiaMon = (SELECT MAX(DonGiaMon) FROM vw_ai_thungan WHERE LoaiBanGhi = 'DONG_MON' AND BusinessDate = CURRENT_DATE AND SoLuongMon > 0) LIMIT 500

SELECT TenNhom, SUM(SoLuongMon) AS SoLuongBan FROM vw_ai_thungan WHERE LoaiBanGhi = 'DONG_MON' AND DATE_FORMAT(BusinessDate, '%Y-%m') = DATE_FORMAT(CURRENT_DATE, '%Y-%m') GROUP BY TenNhom ORDER BY SoLuongBan DESC LIMIT 500
SELECT MaNguyenLieu, TenNguyenLieu, DonViTinh, SoLuongTon, MucTonToiThieu FROM vw_ai_kho WHERE LoaiBanGhi = 'TON_KHO' AND CanhBaoTonThap = 1 LIMIT 500
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT MaNguyenLieu) AS SoNguyenLieuCanhBaoTonThap FROM vw_ai_kho WHERE LoaiBanGhi = 'TON_KHO' AND CanhBaoTonThap = 1 LIMIT 500

SELECT MaLo, MaNguyenLieu, TenNguyenLieu, DonViTinh, SoLuongConLai, NgayNhapLo, HanSuDungLo, TrangThaiLo FROM vw_ai_kho WHERE LoaiBanGhi = 'LO_NGUYEN_LIEU' AND HanSuDungLo >= NOW() AND HanSuDungLo <= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL '-7' DAY) AND SoLuongConLai > 0 ORDER BY HanSuDungLo LIMIT 500
